import numpy as np, scipy.optimize as so
def m(p):
    k,k3,c,c2,F,w,ph,b,G,H,L=p
    return (-k*x-k3*x**3-c*v-c2*v*np.abs(v)+F*np.cos(w*t+ph)+b
            +G*np.cos(w*t)*x+H*np.cos(w*t)*v+L*t)
